smoke_test.check: wrapper self-test (python wrapper.py) in the Legwork sandbox, network off

entrypoint: Offline speech-to-text transcription using Faster-Whisper with a pre-downloaded tiny.en CTranslate2 model
install_command:
pip install "faster-whisper" "av>=10.0.0" numpy huggingface_hub
python - << 'PY'
import os
from huggingface_hub import snapshot_download
os.makedirs("./models", exist_ok=True)
snapshot_download(
    repo_id="Systran/faster-whisper-tiny.en",
    local_dir="./models/faster-whisper-tiny.en",
    local_dir_use_symlinks=False,
    ignore_patterns=["*.md", "*.png", "*.jpg", "*.jpeg", "*.pdf"],
)
print("Model downloaded to ./models/faster-whisper-tiny.en")
PY
